aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Six contestants battle in a live, high-stakes TV quiz show to unravel a closed-circle murder mystery and win a 10 billion yen jackpot.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Six sharp-minded contestants gather on a live television quiz show featuring a massive 10 billion yen jackpot. The game forces them to unravel a complex closed-circle murder mystery, where every clue presented uncovers darker secrets behind the crime. As time ticks down and the pressure builds, alliances shift and personal motives surface on national television.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: MYSTERY ARENA brings together six brilliant contestants from diverse backgrounds to participate in an unprecedented live television quiz event. Enticed by a life-changing 10 billion yen jackpot, the players are tasked with solving a meticulously crafted closed-circle murder mystery in real-time. As the broadcast unfolds, the host presents dynamic evidence, witness testimonies, and intricate crime scene recreations designed to test their deductive capabilities. However, the game rapidly turns sinister as the line between the fictional crime and the participants' real lives begins to blur. Clues dropped throughout the rounds seem deliberately tailored to expose hidden connection between the contestants and the victim. Rivalries intensify as players manipulate one another, desperately trying to hoard crucial information while avoiding public embarrassment on live air. With the jackpot hanging in the balance, each contestant must weigh truth against deception before time runs out. Ultimately, solving the grand puzzle requires revealing not just who committed the murder, but the shocking reason why this arena was constructed in the first place.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: MYSTERY ARENA is an intense psychological thriller that combines the thrill of a live TV game show with the suspense of a classic whodunit. Six contestants compete under the bright lights of a televised arena, solving a locked-room murder case to claim a 10 billion yen prize. As the dynamic quiz progresses through multiple round-based deductions, hidden agendas and personal ties to the mystery come to light, making for a thrilling blend of drama and mystery.

story_structure.climax: A central contestant presents a final, decisive deduction that confronts the core secret of the mystery, exposing the true sequence of events in front of the live audience.
story_structure.conflict: The participants must balance aggressive competition against one another with the cognitive challenge of piecing together the intricate clues of the mystery under intense pressure.
story_structure.resolution: The game concludes, revealing the winner, the true nature of the mystery arena, and the immediate aftermath for the contestants after the broadcast ends.
story_structure.introduction: Six contestants are introduced as they enter the high-stakes live TV show 'MYSTERY ARENA', where a 10 billion yen jackpot awaits anyone who can solve a complex, closed-circle murder mystery.
story_structure.risingAction: As the live broadcast progresses, contestants eliminate obvious suspects, uncover deeper layers of the puzzle, and navigate shifting dynamics as the stakes and tension escalate dramatically.
